name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
October 9, 2012
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Reverend Jesse Ortiz, New Vision Christian Ministries International
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring October 19, 20, and 21, 2012, "Knights of Columbus Tootsie Roll Drive Days" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending August 31, 2012 (CC)
C4.
Sale of City and/or Commission Owned Mobile Homes (CC/CDC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , authorizing the sale of City owned Mobile Homes, and authorizing the City Manager to take any and all necessary actions to implement transactions; and
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2012- , acting as the Housing Authority of the City of Vista, authorizing the sale of Commission owned Mobile Homes, and authorizing the Executive Director to take any and all necessary actions to implement transactions.
C5.
S. Melrose Drive at Shadowridge Drive Eastbound Right Turn Lane Project (CIP 8221) - Award of Construction Contract (CC)
C6.
As-Needed Engineering Geotechnical and Surveying Services Agreements - Amendment (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the first amendment to the agreement with Ninyo & Moore for as-needed geotechnical engineering services;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the first amendment to the agreement with Vinje & Middleton, Inc., for as-needed geotechnical engineering services;
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the first amendment to the agreement with Gold Coast Surveying, Inc., for as-needed engineering surveying services; and
4.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the first amendment to the agreement with Melchior Land Surveying Inc., for as-needed engineering surveying services. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Economic Development Plan Update (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
County Department of Environmental Health Letter Grading of Mobile Food Facilities (CC)
PH2.
Zoning Code and Vista Business Park Specific Plan Amendment (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to consider amendments to various chapters of Title 18 of the Vista Development Code and the Vista Business Park Specific Plan; and
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2012- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California Amending Various Chapters of Title 18 of the Vista Development Code and the Vista Business Park Specific Plan."
PH3.
Conduit Financing for Los Robles Apartments (CC)
1.
Conduct a Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the issuance of tax-exempt obligations and directing certain actions.
PH4.
Nuisance Abatement Hearing - 705, 707 and 709 Hilo Way, Vista, CA (CC)
1.
Conduct a nuisance abatement hearing regarding the condition of the properties at 705, 707 and 709 Hilo Way, Vista, CA; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , declaring that the condition of the properties at 705, 707 and 709 Hilo Way, Vista, California constitutes a public nuisance and authorizing the City Manager to abate the public nuisance.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
